definitions.meaning: A burning flame, flame of fire, burning heat

quotations.english: the gift chair of the Goths was consumed by flames of fire

quotations.old_english: In helle heó brynewelme bídan sceolden sáran sorge
quotations.english: in hell they must endure great sorrow from the burning heat

source_text: bryne-welm, -wylm, es; m. A burning flame, flame of fire, burning heat; incendii fervor vel æstus :-- Brynewylmum mealt gifstól Geáta the gift chair of the Goths was consumed by flames of fire, Beo. Th. 4642; B. 2326: Exon. 42a; Th. 142, 14; Gú. 644. In helle heó brynewelme bídan sceolden sáran sorge in hell they must endure great sorrow from the burning heat, Cd. 213; Th. 266, 24; Sat. 27.
